tasks.title: Run the complete existing-project brownfield journey
tasks.goal: Prove observe→propose→promote→create→verify on a real bounded existing-code fixture.
steps: After M-11-C/D, M-03-E and M-04, bind a preexisting fixture project with intentional desired intent and executable checks.
Run pure intake and explicit promotion, then one admitted existing-file production and current-source verification using the same shared services.
Retain before/after source, intent preservation, production/verification IDs and independent closure evidence; exercise CLI and canonical API entrypoints.
positive_cases: The existing file really changes and its new source is built/tested.
Original desired intent survives intake and explicit promotion.
negative_cases: Disjoint-only candidate output, auto-promotion or old-source tests cannot satisfy the journey.
acceptance: Parent reviewer can inspect exact source and evidence independently of producer success.
tasks.safe_stop: Positive existing-project journey is complete; adversarial replay remains next.
tasks.commit_subject: test(brownfield): prove the complete existing-project transition
notes: Registration perimeter includes existing crate manifests and module owners only for required exports/dependencies; do not change unrelated declarations.

tasks.title: Reject concurrent edits and preserve recovery truth
tasks.goal: Close brownfield applicability and interruption cases across the full journey.
steps: Inject same-length edits, selected file addition/removal, outside-write changes and competing dirty buffers at inventory/promote/create/verify boundaries.
Disconnect/reconnect an operation owner and inject failure after one authored write; use retained journal/transition evidence to inspect exact partial state.
Verify no stale plan replays or automatic production/repair; finish only cases whose recovery is independently checked.
positive_cases: Stable replay returns the existing exact outcome.
Supported interrupted promotion/verification recovery remains inspectable after process exit.
negative_cases: Concurrent input/membership change and foreign parked state refuse.
Cancellation, lost response or unknown third state cannot be reported as rollback/success.
acceptance: Each race identifies the violated witness/ownership condition and completed effects.
Full M-11 closure includes A/B/C/D/E evidence, not D alone.
tasks.safe_stop: Brownfield adversarial matrix is ready for independent parent acceptance.
tasks.commit_subject: test(brownfield): reject stale captures and recover partial changes
notes: Registration perimeter includes existing crate manifests and module owners only for required exports/dependencies; do not change unrelated declarations.
